builder_change.current_resolution: canonical next/content bundle is used whenever it exists; snapshot is considered only when canonical is absent.
builder_change.proposed_resolution: For non-study quiz refs, use study/question_articles/snapshots/<quiz_id>.json when that tracked snapshot exists; otherwise retain the current canonical next/content/<quiz_id>/bundle.json fallback.
builder_change.rationale: A reviewed captured public snapshot is authoritative for an article's runtime revision, while canonical bundles remain the reproducible source for packs without a snapshot.

binding_updates: Replace only the 25 affected revision_sha256 values in question_refs with their matching captured snapshot revisions.
Recompute only the dependent article_sha256 values in the seven review files; article title/body/source_links, factual review verdicts, options, and grading remain untouched.
Regenerate the reader article export only after the builder accepts all bindings.

Add the complementary canonical-only case to assert existing behavior remains unchanged when no snapshot exists.
Validate each of the 25 rewritten refs against its captured snapshot question_id plus revision.sha256, and assert all 25 review hashes match canonical article JSON after the ref-only change.

Run the article builder check and its focused regression test after export; assert the six existing accepted planet-paradoxes-20261010 reader articles are unchanged and no served-pack snapshot is added for its HTTP-400 question pack.
limitations: The audit summary proves the 25 mismatches but does not contain the target served revision hashes. Capturing the five exact public snapshots is required before a safe implementation.
